# =============================================================================
# evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml — cycle-130 Loa 2.0 component ablation suite
#
# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the
# tasks block with the smoke root, phase_defaults, phase_sets, cost_hint, each
# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered
# rules block (D-A5; mirrored in NOTES before the first run, DEC-0383).
#
# Readers: execute-agent.sh / lib/sandbox-mount.sh (arms[].toggles via
# resolve_arm_toggles), pipeline-run.sh (phase_defaults, phase_sets,
# arms[].phases, arms[].effort), took-effect.sh (arms[].took_effect),
# run-ablation.sh (trials, caps, priority, cut_ladder, arms[].task_types),
# ablation-report.py (rules), validate-suite.sh (arm ids for the leakage check,
# task_types against the known types).
#
# task_types: `all` | `build` (= feature-build, bug-fix, refactor) |
#   `review-catch` | a single build type. An arm is never scheduled, and a row
#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).
# took_effect: rule ids took-effect.sh evaluates per trial (DEC-0418); a miss is
#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the
#   smoke's evidence line that the planner refused the arm on a review-catch task.
# =============================================================================
name: ablation-2.0
version: 1
source_commit: "ba11b860"   # the pin: the Sprint 259 completion tree (rc.5 + the #1267 mount fix + the harness; .claude/ identical to the Sprint 258 completion tree, DEC-0529; the per-batch .claude/ delta vs 4d69c3c4 is in MANIFEST.json, DEC-0392)
agy_opt_in: false
tasks:
  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256
  smoke_root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/smoke
suite_version: 1
trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250}   # reserve released to A7 when the re-verification rule needs no run (DEC-0398)
priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)

# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
phase_defaults:
  models:
    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
  # REVIEW/AUDIT 60 turns / 30 min: the Sprint 258 smoke saw a review-catch AUDIT hit 40 turns after writing its
  # verdict (DEC-0490); BARE stays the implementer-side sum (PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX)
  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 60, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 60, BARE: 170}
  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 30, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 30, BARE: 70}
  tools: "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"   # identical for every arm, A0 included
phase_sets:   # D-4.1: A1's phases per task type; FIX runs only after a CHANGES_REQUIRED gate
  review-catch: [REVIEW, AUDIT]
  build: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX]

arms:
  - {id: a0_bare, label: A0, task_types: [all], toggles: {loa_mount: false}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},
     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],
     took_effect: [no_plan_phase, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},
     phases: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT],
     took_effect: [no_gate_phases, enforce_env_false, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}   # build only: on a review-catch task the gates are the task (DEC-0400)
  - {id: a5_no_flatline, label: A5, task_types: [build], toggles: {flatline: false},
     took_effect: [no_flatline_rows, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a6_one_window, label: A6, task_types: [build], toggles: {context_resets: false},
     took_effect: [implementer_single_session, gates_separate_sessions, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a7_effort_medium, label: A7, task_types: [all], toggles: {effort: medium},
     took_effect: [effort_flag_medium, skill_effort_stripped, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a8_no_ceremonies, label: A8, absent: true,
     evidence: "no /meeting command, skill or sosyete config key at 4d69c3c4 (grep -rli sosyete .claude/ docs/; ls .claude/commands .claude/skills)"}

rules:   # D-A5: pre-registered, mirrored in NOTES
  threshold_points: 0.03
  cost_lower_pct: 15
  bootstrap: {resamples: 10000, level: 0.90, paired: true, units: {hidden_test_pass_rate: tasks, defect_catch_rate: defects}, also_report: {defect_catch_rate: tasks}}   # DEC-0399
  primaries_by_arm: {build_only: [hidden_test_pass_rate], all_types: [hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate]}   # DEC-0400
  cap_failure: counts_as_failed            # 0 on each applicable primary (DEC-0393)
  exclusion: {statuses: [degraded, contaminated, interrupted], mode: pairwise, inconclusive_above_share: 0.25}
  sensitivity_figure: cap_failures_excluded  # printed, never decides
  multiple_comparisons: none                 # expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed
  drift_guard: {cli_version: fixed_per_batch, model_ids: fixed_per_batch}   # DEC-0407
  order: trial_major_seeded_shuffle_within_block
  took_effect_per_trial: true                # a miss → infrastructure_error, arm paused until --clear-arm (DEC-0418)
  predicates:                                # DEC-0416, DEC-0393, DEC-0530; d = arm − A1 point estimate, [lo, hi] its 90 % interval, c/w = cost/wall-clock Δ %; evaluated in this order
    inconclusive_by_degradation: "the arm's excluded share > 0.25 (whatever its interval; DEC-0393)"
    investigate: "else any applicable primary has lo > 0"
    keep: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03 and hi < 0"
    inconclusive: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03, or no valid pair"
    remove: "else every applicable primary has d >= -0.03 and (c <= -15 or w <= -15)"
    simplify: "else (every applicable primary within -0.03, cost similar)"
  review_catch: {defect_counts_once_across_gates: true, false_positive_dedupe: cited_region, verdict_accurate_iff: "CHANGES_REQUIRED when the key holds a high or critical defect, APPROVED when none"}   # DEC-0420
  inconclusive_extension_trials: 2
  h1: "a1_full beats a0_bare on at least one primary with the interval excluding zero, else halt before promotion"
  a4_sensitivity: "a4_no_gates worse than a1_full on hidden_test_pass_rate with the interval excluding zero, else harden tasks before acting on other arms"
  decision_states: [investigate, keep, inconclusive, remove, simplify, not_run_cut, inconclusive_by_power]
  mde_cut: 0.10   # sprint Task 3.4: an arm whose MDE at affordable trials exceeds this is pre-declared inconclusive_by_power and not run

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	# =============================================================================
3	# ablation-report.py — the cycle-130 ablation report (PRD FR-8, SDD §5.12, §4.2)
4	#
5	# Reads runs.jsonl rows (SDD §3.1, ablation-row.sh), the batch MANIFEST.json files
6	# (SDD §3.4, run-ablation.sh) and the suite file (evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:
7	# arms[], trials, cut_ladder, priority and the pre-registered `rules` block, D-A5),
8	# applies the pre-registered rules to every component arm (A2 … A7) against the
9	# control a1_full, checks H1 (a1_full vs a0_bare) and the A4 sensitivity rule, and
10	# writes report.md (and a --json twin with the same numbers).
11	#
12	# Usage:
13	#   ablation-report.py --runs F [--runs F ...] --manifests DIR [--manifests DIR ...]
14	#                      --suite F --out report.md [--json report.json]
15	#                      [--seed 20261015] [--resamples N] [--level L]
16	#                      [--exclude-degraded true|false] [--partial]
17	#                      [--cuts F] [--not-run CSV]
18	#
19	# Options:
20	#   --runs F            a runs.jsonl file (repeatable). Every non-blank line is one row
21	#                       and must carry schema_version 1 (an integer, or a "1.x" string);
22	#                       a row with another major, no schema_version, or a line that is not
23	#                       a JSON object stops the report (exit 2, naming file:line and run_id).
24	#                       A run_id seen twice keeps its last row (the earlier one is listed).
25	#   --manifests DIR     a directory searched recursively (symlinks not followed) for
26	#                       MANIFEST.json files (repeatable). Each gives a batch's provenance:
27	#                       batch, arm_map, shuffle_seed, source_commit, suite_manifest_sha256,
28	#                       suite_version, pre_registration_ref, cli_version (top level or
29	#                       executor.cli_version), image_digest, smoke. A manifest with an
30	#                       unknown schema_version major, two manifests claiming one batch, or
31	#                       an arm_map entry disagreeing with a row's arm → exit 2.
32	#   --suite F           the suite file: YAML read through `yq -o=json` (mikefarah yq v4,
33	#                       as arms-report.py does), or JSON when the file parses as JSON.
34	#                       The Method section quotes its `rules:` block verbatim.
35	#   --out F             report.md (the only files written are --out and --json; a symlink
36	#                       at either path is refused)
37	#   --json F            the JSON twin (schema_version 1)
38	#   --seed N            bootstrap seed (default 20261015); every interval uses its own
39	#                       random.Random(seed), so a figure does not depend on which other
40	#                       arms are present
41	#   --resamples N       default rules.bootstrap.resamples (10,000); a value other than the
42	#                       pre-registered one is marked in the header
43	#   --level L           default rules.bootstrap.level (0.90); same marking
44	#   --exclude-degraded  true (default) | false: rows with degraded: true are excluded
45	#                       pairwise (rules.exclusion.statuses names `degraded`)
46	#   --partial           prints "PARTIAL — rows so far, no decision is final"; exit 1 when no
47	#                       comparison (A2–A7, H1, A4) has a valid pair on every primary it uses
48	#   --cuts F            a JSON list of {arm, reason, figure[, state]} the lead recorded;
49	#                       arm is an id (a5_no_flatline) or a label (A5); state is not_run_cut
50	#                       (default) or inconclusive_by_power (a pre-declared power cut)
51	#   --not-run CSV       arm ids or labels read as Not run (cut) with figure "--not-run"
52	#
53	# Row treatment (DEC-0393, DEC-0417):
54	#   not decided, listed  rows of a smoke batch (manifest smoke: true), rows whose batch has
55	#                        no manifest, rows of an arm the suite does not run (absent or
56	#                        unknown), rows on a task type outside the arm's task_types
57	#                        (applicability refusals; not counted in the excluded share)
58	#   excluded pairwise    status in rules.exclusion.statuses plus transport_error and
59	#                        infrastructure_error (DEC-0417), degraded: true (with
60	#                        --exclude-degraded true), and a scoring status whose primary is
61	#                        null (ungraded); the task-trial cell leaves BOTH arms of every
62	#                        comparison it is in; a cell holding a valid row (a rerun) is valid
63	#   cap_failure          0 on every applicable primary (pass rate 0, every defect missed)
64	#   completed, agent_error  score what the row holds (hidden_test_pass_rate; defects)
65	#   The sensitivity figure repeats the comparison with cap_failure excluded pairwise
66	#   instead of scored 0; no decision reads it.
67	#
68	# Statistics (pre-registered in the suite's rules block; formulas in the Method section):
69	#   pass rate unit  the task: per task, the mean over its valid trials, arm minus a1_full
70	#   catch-rate unit the defect: per review-catch task and defect dK, the share of the
71	#                   arm's valid trials that caught it, arm minus a1_full; per-defect ids
72	#                   come from the row's `defects_missed` (or `recall.missed`) list of dK
73	#                   ids when present, else each defect of the task takes the row's
74	#                   defect_catch_rate (aggregate rows); the task-level figure is also
75	#                   reported (rules.bootstrap.also_report) and decides nothing
76	#   interval        percentile bootstrap of the mean paired difference: `resamples`
77	#                   resamples with replacement, linear interpolation between order
78	#                   statistics, [lo, hi] = the (1-level)/2 and 1-(1-level)/2 quantiles
79	#   d               the mean of the paired differences (not the bootstrap mean)
80	#   c, w            cost and wall-clock delta in percent against a1_full,
81	#                   (mean_arm − mean_a1) / mean_a1 × 100, over the per-task means of the
82	#                   cells the primaries paired
83	#   MDE             (z(1−(1−level)/2) + z(0.90)) × sd(paired diffs) / sqrt(n): the smallest
84	#                   true mean difference a paired test at the report level detects with 0.90
85	#                   power at the available n; n < 2 → n/a
86	#   comparisons     every predicate compares values rounded to 9 decimals, so a planted
87	#                   −0.03 reads −0.03 and not −0.030000000000000027
88	#
89	# Decision per arm (rules.predicates, first match, DEC-0416, with DEC-0393's guard first):
90	#   the degradation guard (excluded share > rules.exclusion.inconclusive_above_share →
91	#   inconclusive, labelled Inconclusive-by-degradation, whatever the interval) →
92	#   investigate → keep → inconclusive (d < -0.03 or no valid pair) → remove → simplify. Then: an arm named by --cuts / --not-run reads
93	#   Not run (cut) or Inconclusive-by-power with the lead's figure; an arm whose MDE on an
94	#   applicable primary exceeds rules.mde_cut and whose predicate outcome is remove or
95	#   simplify reads Inconclusive-by-power with the figure (a null result the sample could
96	#   not have detected); A8 (absent: true) reads component-absent with the suite evidence.
97	#
98	# Exit codes:
99	#   0  report written
100	#   1  --partial and no decidable comparison (the report is still written)
101	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, unknown schema major, provenance conflict
102	#
103	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-report.bats (planted rows generated by
104	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py).
105	# =============================================================================

168	def schema_major(v):
169	    if isinstance(v, bool):
170	        return None
171	    if isinstance(v, int):
172	        return v
173	    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
174	        return int(v)

180	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
181	    """Linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default 'linear')."""
182	    n = len(sorted_xs)
183	    if n == 0:
184	        return None
185	    pos = q * (n - 1)
186	    lo = int(math.floor(pos))
187	    hi = min(lo + 1, n - 1)
188	    frac = pos - lo
189	    return sorted_xs[lo] + (sorted_xs[hi] - sorted_xs[lo]) * frac

192	def bootstrap(diffs, resamples, level, seed):
193	    if not diffs:
194	        return None, None
195	    rng = random.Random(seed)
196	    n = len(diffs)
197	    means = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diffs, k=n)) / n for _ in range(resamples))
198	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
199	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)

202	def mde(diffs, level):
203	    if len(diffs) < 2:
204	        return None
205	    nd = statistics.NormalDist()
206	    z = nd.inv_cdf(1.0 - (1.0 - level) / 2.0) + nd.inv_cdf(POWER)
207	    return z * statistics.stdev(diffs) / math.sqrt(len(diffs))

210	def collapse(run_ids):
211	    """batch-arm-task-t1, -t2, -t3 → batch-arm-task-t1…t3 (non-contiguous: t1,t3)."""
212	    groups, other = {}, []
213	    for rid in run_ids:
214	        m = re.fullmatch(r"(.*-t)(\d+)", rid)
215	        if m:
216	            groups.setdefault(m.group(1), []).append(int(m.group(2)))
217	        else:
218	            other.append(rid)
219	    out = []
220	    for prefix in sorted(groups):
221	        ns = sorted(set(groups[prefix]))
222	        if len(ns) == 1:
223	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}")
224	        elif len(ns) >= 3 and ns == list(range(ns[0], ns[-1] + 1)):
225	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}…t{ns[-1]}")
226	        else:
227	            out.append(prefix + ",t".join(str(n) for n in ns))
228	    return out + sorted(other)

377	class Analysis:
378	    def __init__(self, suite, rows, mans, args, cap_excluded):
379	        self.suite, self.rules, self.args = suite, suite["rules"], args
380	        self.cap_excluded = cap_excluded
381	        self.arms = {a["id"]: a for a in suite["arms"] if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id")}
382	        ex = self.rules.get("exclusion") or {}
383	        self.ex_statuses = set(ex.get("statuses") or []) | set(DEC0417_EXCLUDED)
384	        self.guard = float(ex.get("inconclusive_above_share", 0.25))
385	        self.listed = []        # rows that never enter a decision, with the reason
386	        self.excluded = []      # excluded rows (status/reason), superseded included
387	        self.cells = {}         # (arm, task) -> {trial: {"valid": row|None, "rows": [...]}}
388	        self.task_type = {}
389	        self.task_defects = {}
390	        self.arm_rows = {}
391	        for row in rows:
392	            seeded = row.get("defects_seeded")
393	            if isinstance(seeded, int) and not isinstance(seeded, bool) and seeded > 0:
394	                self.task_defects[row["task_id"]] = max(self.task_defects.get(row["task_id"], 0), seeded)
395	        for row in rows:
396	            self._classify(row, mans)
397	        for (arm, task), trials in self.cells.items():
398	            for t, cell in trials.items():
399	                valid = [x for x in cell["rows"] if x["_valid"]]
400	                cell["valid"] = valid[-1] if valid else None
401	                for x in cell["rows"]:
402	                    if x["_valid"] and x is not cell["valid"]:
403	                        self.excluded.append(self._exrow(x, f"duplicate cell; superseded by {cell['valid']['run_id']}",
404	                                                         counted=False))
405	                    elif not x["_valid"]:
406	                        sup = f"; superseded by {cell['valid']['run_id']}" if cell["valid"] else ""
407	                        self.excluded.append(self._exrow(x, x["_reason"] + sup, counted=not cell["valid"]))
408	
409	    @staticmethod
410	    def _exrow(x, reason, counted):
411	        return {"run_id": x["run_id"], "arm": x["arm"], "task_id": x["task_id"], "trial": x["trial"],
412	                "status": x["status"], "reason": reason, "cell_excluded": counted}
413	
414	    def applies(self, arm, ttype):
415	        types = self.arms[arm].get("task_types") or []
416	        return "all" in types or ttype in types or ("build" in types and ttype in BUILD_TYPES)
417	
418	    def primaries(self, arm):
419	        types = self.arms[arm].get("task_types") or []
420	        pba = self.rules.get("primaries_by_arm") or {}
421	        if "all" in types or REVIEW in types:
422	            return list(pba.get("all_types") or [PASS, CATCH])
423	        return list(pba.get("build_only") or [PASS])
424	
425	    def _classify(self, row, mans):
426	        arm, task, ttype = row["arm"], row["task_id"], row["task_type"]
427	        m = mans.get(row["batch"])
428	        if m is None:
429	            return self.listed.append((row, "no manifest for batch " + row["batch"]))
430	        amap = m.get("arm_map") or {}
431	        if isinstance(amap, dict) and row["run_id"] in amap and amap[row["run_id"]] != arm:
432	            raise Fail(f"{row['_where']}: row {row['run_id']} arm {arm} disagrees with "
433	                       f"{m['_path']} arm_map ({amap[row['run_id']]})")
434	        if m.get("smoke") is True:
435	            return self.listed.append((row, "smoke batch " + row["batch"]))
436	        if arm not in self.arms or self.arms[arm].get("absent"):
437	            return self.listed.append((row, f"arm {arm} is not run by the suite"))
438	        if ttype not in BUILD_TYPES and ttype != REVIEW:
439	            return self.listed.append((row, f"unknown task_type {ttype}"))
440	        if not self.applies(arm, ttype):
441	            return self.listed.append((row, f"not applicable: {arm} does not run {ttype} tasks"))
442	        self.task_type[task] = ttype
443	        self.arm_rows.setdefault(arm, []).append(row)
444	        st = row["status"]
445	        reason = None
446	        if st in self.ex_statuses:
447	            reason = st
448	        elif self.args.exclude_degraded and row.get("degraded") is True:
449	            reason = "degraded: " + str(row.get("degraded_reason") or "no reason recorded")
450	        elif st not in SCORING:
451	            reason = "status " + st
452	        elif st == "cap_failure" and self.cap_excluded:
453	            reason = "cap_failure (sensitivity figure)"
454	        elif st != "cap_failure":
455	            if ttype == REVIEW and not isinstance(row.get(CATCH), (int, float)):
456	                reason = "ungraded (defect_catch_rate null)"
457	            elif ttype != REVIEW and not isinstance(row.get(PASS), (int, float)):
458	                reason = "ungraded (hidden_test_pass_rate null)"
459	        row["_valid"] = reason is None
460	        row["_reason"] = reason
461	        cell = self.cells.setdefault((arm, task), {}).setdefault(row["trial"], {"valid": None, "rows": []})
462	        cell["rows"].append(row)
463	
464	    # -- scores
465	    def pass_score(self, row):
466	        return 0.0 if row["status"] == "cap_failure" else float(row[PASS])
467	
468	    def catch_task_score(self, row):
469	        return 0.0 if row["status"] == "cap_failure" else float(row[CATCH])
470	
471	    def defect_vector(self, row):
472	        n = self.task_defects.get(row["task_id"], 0)
473	        if n <= 0:
474	            return None, "none"
475	        if row["status"] == "cap_failure":
476	            return [0.0] * n, "cap"
477	        missed = row.get("defects_missed")
478	        if missed is None and isinstance(row.get("recall"), dict):
479	            missed = row["recall"].get("missed")
480	        if isinstance(missed, list) and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in missed):
481	            ms = set(missed)
482	            return [0.0 if f"d{k}" in ms else 1.0 for k in range(1, n + 1)], "ids"
483	        return [float(row[CATCH])] * n, "rate"
484	
485	    # -- shares
486	    def excluded_share(self, arm):
487	        cells = [c for (a, _), trials in self.cells.items() if a == arm for c in trials.values()]
488	        if not cells:
489	            return None, 0, 0
490	        ex = sum(1 for c in cells if c["valid"] is None)
491	        return ex / len(cells), ex, len(cells)
492	
493	    # -- one paired comparison of `arm` against `ctrl` on one primary
494	    def compare(self, arm, ctrl, metric, seed):
495	        types = (REVIEW,) if metric == CATCH else BUILD_TYPES
496	        tasks = sorted({t for (a, t) in self.cells if a in (arm, ctrl) and self.task_type.get(t) in types})
497	        res = {"metric": metric, "arm": arm, "control": ctrl, "unit": "tasks", "pairs": [], "unpaired": [],
498	               "dropped": [], "diffs": [], "task_diffs": [], "defect_identity": set()}
499	        for task in tasks:
500	            ca, cc = self.cells.get((arm, task), {}), self.cells.get((ctrl, task), {})
501	            drop = sorted(t for t in set(ca) | set(cc)
502	                          if (t in ca and ca[t]["valid"] is None) or (t in cc and cc[t]["valid"] is None))
503	            for t in drop:
504	                for side, cs in ((arm, ca), (ctrl, cc)):
505	                    if t in cs and cs[t]["valid"] is not None:
506	                        res["dropped"].append({"task_id": task, "trial": t, "arm": side,
507	                                               "run_id": cs[t]["valid"]["run_id"]})
508	            va = [ca[t]["valid"] for t in sorted(ca) if t not in drop]
509	            vc = [cc[t]["valid"] for t in sorted(cc) if t not in drop]
510	            if not va or not vc:
511	                why = []
512	                for side, cs, vs in ((arm, ca, va), (ctrl, cc, vc)):
513	                    if vs:
514	                        continue
515	                    if not cs:
516	                        why.append(f"no row in {side}")
517	                    elif all(cs[t]["valid"] is None for t in cs):
518	                        why.append(f"every cell of {side} excluded")
519	                    else:
520	                        why.append(f"the cells of {side} dropped pairwise")
521	                res["unpaired"].append({"task_id": task, "reason": "; ".join(why)})
522	                continue
523	            pair = {"task_id": task, "arm_runs": [r["run_id"] for r in va], "control_runs": [r["run_id"] for r in vc],
524	                    "arm_cost": mean([float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0) for r in va]),
525	                    "control_cost": mean([float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0) for r in vc]),
526	                    "arm_wall": mean([float(r.get("wall_clock_ms") or 0) for r in va]),
527	                    "control_wall": mean([float(r.get("wall_clock_ms") or 0) for r in vc])}
528	            if metric == PASS:
529	                ma, mc = mean([self.pass_score(r) for r in va]), mean([self.pass_score(r) for r in vc])
530	                pair.update(arm_value=ma, control_value=mc, diff=ma - mc)
531	                res["diffs"].append(ma - mc)
532	                res["task_diffs"].append(ma - mc)
533	            else:
534	                ma, mc = mean([self.catch_task_score(r) for r in va]), mean([self.catch_task_score(r) for r in vc])
535	                pair.update(arm_value=ma, control_value=mc, diff=ma - mc)
536	                res["task_diffs"].append(ma - mc)
537	                vecs_a = [self.defect_vector(r) for r in va]
538	                vecs_c = [self.defect_vector(r) for r in vc]
539	                for _, how in vecs_a + vecs_c:
540	                    res["defect_identity"].add(how)
541	                if all(v is not None for v, _ in vecs_a + vecs_c):
542	                    n = len(vecs_a[0][0])
543	                    dd = [mean([v[k] for v, _ in vecs_a]) - mean([v[k] for v, _ in vecs_c]) for k in range(n)]
544	                    pair["defects"] = n
545	                    pair["defect_diffs"] = dd
546	                    res["diffs"].extend(dd)
547	                else:
548	                    pair["defects"] = 0
549	            res["pairs"].append(pair)
550	        if metric == CATCH:
551	            res["unit"] = "defects"
552	        res["defect_identity"] = sorted(res["defect_identity"] - {"cap"})
553	        n = len(res["diffs"])
554	        res["n"] = n
555	        res["n_tasks"] = len(res["pairs"])
556	        res["d"] = mean(res["diffs"]) if n else None
557	        res["lo"], res["hi"] = bootstrap(res["diffs"], self.args.resamples, self.args.level, seed)
558	        res["mde"] = mde(res["diffs"], self.args.level)
559	        res["half_width"] = None if res["lo"] is None else (res["hi"] - res["lo"]) / 2.0
560	        if metric == CATCH:
561	            td = res["task_diffs"]
562	            lo, hi = bootstrap(td, self.args.resamples, self.args.level, seed)
563	            res["task_level"] = {"unit": "tasks", "n": len(td), "d": mean(td) if td else None, "lo": lo, "hi": hi}
564	        return res

566	    def deltas(self, comps):
567	        """c and w over the per-task means of the cells the primaries paired."""
568	        per_task = {}
569	        for comp in comps:
570	            for p in comp["pairs"]:
571	                per_task.setdefault(p["task_id"], p)
572	        if not per_task:
573	            return None, None, 0
574	        ps = [per_task[t] for t in sorted(per_task)]
575	
576	        def delta(a, c):
577	            ma, mc = mean([p[a] for p in ps]), mean([p[c] for p in ps])
578	            return None if not mc else (ma - mc) / mc * 100.0
579	
580	        return delta("arm_cost", "control_cost"), delta("arm_wall", "control_wall"), len(ps)
581	
582	    def decide(self, arm, comps, c, w, share):
583	        T = float(self.rules.get("threshold_points", 0.03))
584	        C = float(self.rules.get("cost_lower_pct", 15))
585	        P = [p for p in comps if p["n"] > 0]
586	        nopair = len(P) < len(comps)
587	        name = lambda p: p["metric"]  # noqa: E731
588	        if share is not None and r9(share) > self.guard:
589	            # DEC-0393: the degradation guard reads first, whatever the interval (lead's ruling, Sprint 260)
590	            clause = f"excluded share {share:.3f} > {self.guard:g}"
591	            return "inconclusive", f"inconclusive (degradation guard, evaluated first): {clause}", [clause]
592	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["lo"]) > 0]
593	        if hits:
594	            return "investigate", f"investigate: any applicable primary has lo > 0 ({', '.join(hits)})", []
595	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["d"]) < -T and r9(p["hi"]) < 0]
596	        if hits:
597	            return "keep", f"keep: any applicable primary has d < -{T:g} and hi < 0 ({', '.join(hits)})", []
598	        clauses = []
599	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["d"]) < -T]
600	        if hits:
601	            clauses.append(f"d < -{T:g} ({', '.join(hits)})")
602	        if nopair:
603	            clauses.append("no valid pair (" + ", ".join(name(p) for p in comps if p["n"] == 0) + ")")
604	        if clauses:
605	            return "inconclusive", "inconclusive: " + "; ".join(clauses), clauses
606	        cost_ok = (c is not None and r9(c) <= -C) or (w is not None and r9(w) <= -C)
607	        if all(r9(p["d"]) >= -T for p in comps) and cost_ok:
608	            which = []
609	            if c is not None and r9(c) <= -C:
610	                which.append(f"c = {c:+.1f}")
611	            if w is not None and r9(w) <= -C:
612	                which.append(f"w = {w:+.1f}")
613	            return "remove", (f"remove: every applicable primary has d >= -{T:g} and "
614	                              f"(c <= -{C:g} or w <= -{C:g}) ({', '.join(which)})"), []
615	        return "simplify", f"simplify: every applicable primary within -{T:g}, cost similar", []

617	    def arm_report(self, arm, cuts, seed):
618	        prims = self.primaries(arm)
619	        comps = [self.compare(arm, CONTROL, m, seed) for m in prims]
620	        c, w, n_cost = self.deltas(comps)
621	        share, ex, seen = self.excluded_share(arm)
622	        out = {"arm": arm, "arm_label": self.arms[arm].get("label", arm), "primaries": prims,
623	               "comparisons": comps, "c": c, "w": w, "cost_tasks": n_cost,
624	               "excluded_share": share, "excluded_cells": ex, "cells_seen": seen}
625	        if not seen:
626	            state, rule, clauses = "no_rows", "no rows for this arm", []
627	        else:
628	            state, rule, clauses = self.decide(arm, comps, c, w, share)
629	        out["predicate_state"] = state
630	        out["predicate_rule"] = rule
631	        label = DISPLAY.get(state, state)
632	        if state == "inconclusive" and any(cl.startswith("excluded share") for cl in clauses):
633	            label = "Inconclusive-by-degradation"
634	        out["predicate_label"] = label
635	        figure = None
636	        mde_cut = self.rules.get("mde_cut")
637	        over = [p for p in comps if p["mde"] is not None and mde_cut is not None and r9(p["mde"]) > float(mde_cut)]
638	        if arm in cuts:
639	            cut = cuts[arm]
640	            state, label = cut["state"], DISPLAY[cut["state"]]
641	            rule = f"{cut['source']}: {cut['reason']}".rstrip(": ")
642	            figure = cut["figure"]
643	        elif state in ("remove", "simplify") and over:
644	            figure = "; ".join(f"MDE {p['mde']:.3f} > {float(mde_cut):g} on {p['metric']} (n = {p['n']} {p['unit']})"
645	                               for p in over)
646	            rule = f"inconclusive_by_power: {figure} (predicate read {DISPLAY[out['predicate_state']]})"
647	            state, label = "inconclusive_by_power", DISPLAY["inconclusive_by_power"]
648	        out.update(state=state, label=label, rule=rule, figure=figure,
649	                   mde_flag=[p["metric"] for p in over])
650	        out["decidable"] = bool(seen) and all(p["n"] > 0 for p in comps)
651	        return out

653	    def arm_metrics(self, arm):
654	        """Unpaired per-arm figures (AC-8.2): task-mean of trial means and the secondaries."""
655	        rows = self.arm_rows.get(arm, [])
656	        valid = [c["valid"] for (a, _), trials in sorted(self.cells.items()) if a == arm
657	                 for _, c in sorted(trials.items()) if c["valid"] is not None]
658	        by_task = {}
659	        for r in valid:
660	            by_task.setdefault(r["task_id"], []).append(r)
661	        status = {}
662	        for r in rows:
663	            status[r["status"]] = status.get(r["status"], 0) + 1
664	
665	        def task_mean(rs_by_task, f):
666	            return mean([mean([f(r) for r in rs]) for rs in rs_by_task.values()])
667	
668	        build = {t: rs for t, rs in by_task.items() if self.task_type[t] in BUILD_TYPES}
669	        rc = {t: rs for t, rs in by_task.items() if self.task_type[t] == REVIEW}
670	
671	        def bools(key):
672	            vs = [r.get(key) for r in valid if isinstance(r.get(key), bool)]
673	            return None if not vs else sum(1 for v in vs if v) / len(vs)
674	
675	        def nums(key, rs=None):
676	            vs = [r.get(key) for r in (valid if rs is None else rs)
677	                  if isinstance(r.get(key), (int, float)) and not isinstance(r.get(key), bool)]
678	            return mean(vs)

680	        return {

682	            "degraded_rows": sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("degraded") is True),
683	            "valid_cells": len(valid),

685	            CATCH: task_mean(rc, self.catch_task_score) if rc else None,
686	            "verdict_accuracy": bools("verdict_accuracy"),

688	            "verdict_accuracy_audit": bools("verdict_accuracy_audit"),
689	            "false_positives_per_task": {t: nums("false_positives", rs) for t, rs in sorted(rc.items())},
690	            "regressions_per_run": nums("regressions"),
691	            "diff_lines_per_run": nums("diff_lines"), "files_changed_per_run": nums("files_changed"),
692	            "cost_per_task": task_mean(by_task, lambda r: float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0)) if by_task else None,
693	            "cost_per_run": nums("cost_usd"),
694	            "wall_clock_ms_per_run": nums("wall_clock_ms"),

# then the extra models {<raw id>: {phases: [<label>…], output_tokens: N}} ({} when none).
# Read-only on the run dir. A phase drifts on model grounds only when its model_requested
# differs from MANIFEST phase_models[name], or when the requested model (else the manifest's)
# is absent from a non-empty models_used; any other models_used key is an extra model (a

drift_check() {
  python3 -I - "$1" "$MAN_PATH" "$2" <<'PY'

rd, man, rid = sys.argv[1:4]
m = json.load(open(man)); p = json.load(open(os.path.join(rd, "meta", "pipeline.json")))
def norm(x):   # ablation-row.sh norm_model
    x = re.sub(r"^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.", "", str(x)); return re.sub(r"-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$", "", x)
pm = m.get("phase_models") or {}
extra, first = {}, None
def hit(field, exp, got):
    global first
    if first is None: first = {"run_id": rid, "field": field, "expected": exp, "got": got}
for ph in p.get("phases") or []:
    if not isinstance(ph, dict) or ph.get("skipped"): continue
    name, label = ph.get("name") or "", ph.get("label") or ph.get("name") or ""
    req = ph.get("model_requested")
    if name in pm and req is not None and norm(req) != norm(pm[name]):
        hit("model_requested." + label, pm[name], req)
    mu = ph.get("models_used") if isinstance(ph.get("models_used"), dict) else {}
    want = req if isinstance(req, str) and req else pm.get(name)
    if not mu or not want: continue
    if norm(want) not in {norm(k) for k in mu}:
        hit("models_used." + label, norm(pm.get(name) or want), sorted(mu))
        continue
    for k in sorted(mu):
        if norm(k) == norm(want): continue
        e = extra.setdefault(k, {"phases": [], "output_tokens": 0})
        e["phases"].append(label)
        v = mu[k]
        if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool): e["output_tokens"] += int(v)

                    if isinstance(v, str) and v: seen.append((os.path.basename(f), v))

        for f, v in seen:
            got = re.search(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", v)

    elif not seen and m.get("image_digest") and p.get("image_digest") and m["image_digest"] != p["image_digest"]:

print(json.dumps(extra, sort_keys=True))
PY

# drift_check <run-dir> <run_id> → two lines: the drift {run_id, field, expected, got} or null,
# then the extra models {<raw id>: {phases: [<label>…], output_tokens: N}} ({} when none).
# Read-only on the run dir. A phase drifts on model grounds only when its model_requested
# differs from MANIFEST phase_models[name], or when the requested model (else the manifest's)
# is absent from a non-empty models_used; any other models_used key is an extra model (a
# WebFetch summariser or a built-in subagent: telemetry, DEC-0545)
drift_check() {
  python3 -I - "$1" "$MAN_PATH" "$2" <<'PY'
import glob, json, os, re, sys
rd, man, rid = sys.argv[1:4]
m = json.load(open(man)); p = json.load(open(os.path.join(rd, "meta", "pipeline.json")))
def norm(x):   # ablation-row.sh norm_model
    x = re.sub(r"^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.", "", str(x)); return re.sub(r"-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$", "", x)
pm = m.get("phase_models") or {}
extra, first = {}, None
def hit(field, exp, got):
    global first
    if first is None: first = {"run_id": rid, "field": field, "expected": exp, "got": got}
for ph in p.get("phases") or []:
    if not isinstance(ph, dict) or ph.get("skipped"): continue
    name, label = ph.get("name") or "", ph.get("label") or ph.get("name") or ""
    req = ph.get("model_requested")
    if name in pm and req is not None and norm(req) != norm(pm[name]):
        hit("model_requested." + label, pm[name], req)
    mu = ph.get("models_used") if isinstance(ph.get("models_used"), dict) else {}
    want = req if isinstance(req, str) and req else pm.get(name)
    if not mu or not want: continue
    if norm(want) not in {norm(k) for k in mu}:
        hit("models_used." + label, norm(pm.get(name) or want), sorted(mu))
        continue
    for k in sorted(mu):
        if norm(k) == norm(want): continue
        e = extra.setdefault(k, {"phases": [], "output_tokens": 0})
        e["phases"].append(label)
        v = mu[k]
        if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool): e["output_tokens"] += int(v)
if first is None:
    want, seen = m.get("cli_version") or "", []
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(rd, "transcripts", "events-*.jsonl"))):
        with open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
            for n, line in enumerate(fh):
                if n > 200: break
                if '"init"' not in line: continue
                try: e = json.loads(line)
                except ValueError: continue
                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("type") == "system" and e.get("subtype") == "init":
                    v = e.get("claude_code_version") or e.get("version")
                    if isinstance(v, str) and v: seen.append((os.path.basename(f), v))
                    break
    if seen and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", want):
        for f, v in seen:
            got = re.search(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", v)
            if (got.group(0) if got else v) != want: hit("cli_version", want, v); break
    elif not seen and m.get("image_digest") and p.get("image_digest") and m["image_digest"] != p["image_digest"]:
        hit("image_digest", m["image_digest"], p["image_digest"])
print(json.dumps(first) if first is not None else "null")
print(json.dumps(extra, sort_keys=True))
PY
}

  echo "run-ablation (dry run): batch=$BATCH source=${SRC_FULL:0:12} executor=$EXECUTOR image=$IMAGE cli=$CLI_VERSION tree=$TREE"
  echo "$PLAN_LINE"
  jq -r '.refused[] | "refused: \(.arm) \(.task_id) \(.type) (task_types \(.task_types | tojson)) DEC-0405"' "$WORK/plan.json"
  jq -r '.[] | "\(.arm) \(.task_id) \(.type) \(.trial) \(.run_id)"' "$WORK/plan-only.json"
  echo "manifest: $mpath"
  exit 0
fi

# --- --clear-drift and --rerow: checked read-only before the lock (a refusal writes nothing) --
run_dir_of() {  # run_dir_of <run_id> → <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n> or its highest -r<k> sibling; empty when none
  local rel base best k max=1 d
  rel="$(jq -r --arg r "$1" '[.[] | select(.run_id == $r) | .run_dir][0] // ""' "$WORK/plan-only.json")"
  [[ -n "$rel" ]] || return 0
  base="$BATCH_DIR/$rel" best=""
  [[ -d "$base" ]] && best="$base"
  for d in "$base"-r*; do
    [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
    k="${d##*-r}"; [[ "$k" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
    if [[ $k -gt $max ]]; then max=$k best="$d"; fi
  done
  printf '%s' "$best"
}
CLEAR_PENDING=null
if [[ "$CLEAR_DRIFT" == true ]]; then
  old_drift="$(jq -c '.drift' "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json")"
  if [[ "$old_drift" == null ]]; then
    echo "run-ablation: resume: --clear-drift: the batch records no drift; nothing to clear" >&2
  else
    cd_rid="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' <<<"$old_drift")"
    cd_rd="$(run_dir_of "$cd_rid")"
    [[ -n "$cd_rd" && -f "$cd_rd/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || die "resume: --clear-drift: no run dir with meta/pipeline.json for the drifted run $cd_rid"
    cd_now="$(drift_check "$cd_rd" "$cd_rid" | sed -n 1p)" || cd_now=""
    [[ -n "$cd_now" ]] || die "resume: --clear-drift $cd_rid: the drift guard could not read $cd_rd"
    [[ "$cd_now" == null ]] || die "resume: --clear-drift $cd_rid: the run still drifts under the current rule: $cd_now"
    CLEAR_PENDING="$(jq -cn --arg r "$cd_rid" --argjson prev "$old_drift" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
      --arg hc "$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" \
      '{run_id: $r, previous: $prev, cleared_at: $at, harness_commit: $hc}')"
  fi
fi
RR_K=() RR_RD=() RR_FROM=() RR_ATT=() RR_REASON=()
for rid in ${REROW_IDS[@]+"${REROW_IDS[@]}"}; do
  [[ "$rid" == "$BATCH-"* ]] || die "--rerow $rid: not a run of batch $BATCH (<batch>-<arm>-<task>-t<n>)"
  k=-1
  for j in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do [[ "${PL_RUN[$j]}" == "$rid" ]] && { k=$j; break; }; done
  [[ $k -ge 0 ]] || die "--rerow $rid: not in the batch's plan"
  [[ -f "$ROWS" ]] || die "--rerow $rid: no rows file $ROWS"
  rr_rows="$(jq -R -c --arg b "$BATCH" --arg r "$rid" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b and .run_id == $r)' "$ROWS")"
  rr_n="$(grep -c . <<<"$rr_rows" || true)"
  [[ "$rr_n" -eq 1 ]] || die "--rerow $rid: $rr_n rows in $ROWS (a rerow replaces exactly one)"
  rr_st="$(jq -r '.status' <<<"$rr_rows")"
  case "$rr_st" in interrupted|transport_error) die "--rerow $rid: the row is $rr_st; that trial is a rerun (--resume after removing the row), not a rerow" ;; esac
  rr_rd="$(run_dir_of "$rid")"
  [[ -n "$rr_rd" && -f "$rr_rd/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || die "--rerow $rid: no run dir with meta/pipeline.json under $BATCH_DIR"
  RR_K+=("$k"); RR_RD+=("$rr_rd"); RR_FROM+=("$rr_st")
  RR_ATT+=("$(jq -r '.attempts // 1' <<<"$rr_rows")"); RR_REASON+=("$(jq -r '.retry_reason // ""' <<<"$rr_rows")")
done
for rid in ${RERUN_IDS[@]+"${RERUN_IDS[@]}"}; do
  [[ "$rid" == "$BATCH-"* ]] || die "--rerun $rid: not a run of batch $BATCH (<batch>-<arm>-<task>-t<n>)"
  k=-1
  for j in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do [[ "${PL_RUN[$j]}" == "$rid" ]] && { k=$j; break; }; done
  [[ $k -ge 0 ]] || die "--rerun $rid: not in the batch's plan"
  [[ -f "$ROWS" ]] || die "--rerun $rid: no rows file $ROWS"
  rn_rows="$(jq -R -c --arg b "$BATCH" --arg r "$rid" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b and .run_id == $r)' "$ROWS")"
  rn_n="$(grep -c . <<<"$rn_rows" || true)"
  [[ "$rn_n" -eq 1 ]] || die "--rerun $rid: $rn_n rows in $ROWS (a rerun replaces exactly one)"
  rn_st="$(jq -r '.status' <<<"$rn_rows")"
  case "$rn_st" in transport_error|interrupted|infrastructure_error) ;;
    *) die "--rerun $rid: the row is $rn_st; only transport_error, interrupted or infrastructure_error rows are rerun (DEC-0553)" ;; esac
done

# --- batch directory, lock, manifest ---------------------------------------------------
mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR"
LOCK="$BATCH_DIR/.lock"
rmdir_lock() { find "$LOCK" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true; }
if ! mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null; then
  oldpid="$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
  if [[ -n "$oldpid" ]] && kill -0 "$oldpid" 2>/dev/null; then die "batch $BATCH is locked by pid $oldpid ($LOCK)"; fi
  rm -rf "$LOCK"; mkdir "$LOCK" || die "cannot lock $LOCK"
fi
printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$LOCK/pid"
JOBS_DIR="$BATCH_DIR/.jobs"
# a driver killed with SIGKILL leaves its pipelines running in their own sessions: never start
# a second copy of a trial while the first still spends
for f in "$JOBS_DIR"/*.pgid; do
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
  read -r p _ < "$f" 2>/dev/null || continue
  if [[ "$p" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 -- "-$p" 2>/dev/null; then
    rmdir_lock
    die "a pipeline of an earlier driver still runs (process group $p, $f); stop it (kill -TERM -- -$p) or wait, then resume"
  fi
done
rm -rf "$JOBS_DIR"; mkdir -p "$JOBS_DIR"
rm -f "$BATCH_DIR/REFUSED.txt"
LOG="$BATCH_DIR/run.log"
if [[ "$SMOKE" != true && ! -f "$BATCH_DIR/.gitignore" ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' "# run-ablation.sh: run directories, logs and job state stay out of git;" \
    "# MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json and spend.txt are the batch record" "/*/" "/run.log" "/driver.log" "/.lock/" "/.jobs/" \
    > "$BATCH_DIR/.gitignore"
fi
[[ "$RESUME" == true ]] || write_manifest "$MAN_PATH" false
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$ROWS")"

# --- batch state ---------------------------------------------------------------------
STATE=running STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
SPENT=0 ASSUMED_CAP=0 CUT_JSON=null LAUNCHED=0 ROWS_USD=0 LEDGER_USD=0
CUTS_JSON='[]' RETRIES_JSON='[]' PAUSED_JSON='{}' DRIFT_JSON=null ROWS_INVALID=null STOP="" SIGNALLED=false
EXTRA_RUNS_JSON='{}' DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON='[]' REROWED_JSON='[]'
RERUN_JSON='[]' RERUN_OLD='{}' OUTAGE_JSON=null OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON='[]' OUTAGE_RUN=0
DONE_LIST=$'\n' RERUN_LIST=$'\n'
C_PLANNED=() C_LAUNCHED=() C_COMPLETED=() C_FAILED=() C_EXCLUDED=() C_CAP=() C_DEGRADED=() C_SKIPPED=()
for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do
  C_PLANNED[$i]=0; C_LAUNCHED[$i]=0; C_COMPLETED[$i]=0; C_FAILED[$i]=0; C_EXCLUDED[$i]=0; C_CAP[$i]=0; C_DEGRADED[$i]=0; C_SKIPPED[$i]=0
done
arm_index() { local i; for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do [[ "${ARMS[$i]}" == "$1" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done; echo -1; }
for a in ${PL_ARM[@]+"${PL_ARM[@]}"}; do i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_PLANNED[$i]=$(( ${C_PLANNED[$i]} + 1 )); done
is_done() { [[ "$DONE_LIST" == *$'\n'"$1"$'\n'* ]]; }
is_rerun() { [[ "$RERUN_LIST" == *$'\n'"$1"$'\n'* ]]; }   # flagged on resume, no replacement row yet
is_paused() { jq -e --arg a "$1" 'has($a)' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON" >/dev/null; }

# account_row <arm> <kind> <run_id> <status> <cost> <degraded> — counters and spend for one row
account_row() {
  local arm="$1" kind="$2" rid="$3" st="$4" cost="$5" deg="$6" i
  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
  case "$st" in
    completed) C_COMPLETED[$i]=$(( ${C_COMPLETED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
    cap_failure) C_CAP[$i]=$(( ${C_CAP[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
    agent_error) C_FAILED[$i]=$(( ${C_FAILED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
    *) C_EXCLUDED[$i]=$(( ${C_EXCLUDED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
  esac
  [[ "$deg" == true ]] && C_DEGRADED[$i]=$(( ${C_DEGRADED[$i]} + 1 ))
  ROWS_USD="$(fadd "$ROWS_USD" "$cost")"
  if [[ "$st" == cap_failure ]]; then
    if awk -v c="$cost" -v r="$RUN_CAP" 'BEGIN { exit !(c < r) }'; then
      SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
      log "assumed cap: $rid ended cap_failure at USD $cost; USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
    else
      SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
    fi
  else
    spend_charge "$st" "$cost" "$rid"
    if [[ "$st" == completed ]]; then est_record "$arm|$kind" "$kind" "$CHARGED_COST"; fi
  fi
}

resume_cursor() { local k; for k in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do is_done "${PL_RUN[$k]}" || { echo "$k"; return; }; done; echo "$PLAN_N"; }
write_status() {
  local per='{}' i finished=null
  for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do
    per="$(jq -c --arg a "${ARMS[$i]}" --argjson p "${C_PLANNED[$i]}" --argjson l "${C_LAUNCHED[$i]}" \
      --argjson c "${C_COMPLETED[$i]}" --argjson f "${C_FAILED[$i]}" --argjson x "${C_EXCLUDED[$i]}" \
      --argjson cap "${C_CAP[$i]}" --argjson d "${C_DEGRADED[$i]}" --argjson s "${C_SKIPPED[$i]}" \
      '. + {($a): {trials_planned: $p, launched: $l, completed: $c, failed: $f, excluded: $x, cap_failures: $cap,
                   degraded: $d, skipped_paused: $s}}' <<<"$per")"
  done
  [[ "$STATE" != running ]] && finished="\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\""
  jq -n --arg batch "$BATCH" --argjson smoke "$SMOKE" --arg state "$STATE" --argjson per "$per" \
    --argjson retries "$RETRIES_JSON" --argjson cuts "$CUTS_JSON" --argjson paused "$PAUSED_JSON" \
    --arg rows_usd "$ROWS_USD" --arg ledger "$LEDGER_USD" --arg spent "$SPENT" --arg max "$MAX_USD" \
    --argjson assumed "$ASSUMED_CAP" --argjson cursor "$(resume_cursor)" --argjson drift "$DRIFT_JSON" \
    --argjson invalid "$ROWS_INVALID" --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" \
    --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg rows "$ROWS" --argjson planned "$PLAN_N" --argjson signalled "$SIGNALLED" \
    --argjson ebr "$EXTRA_RUNS_JSON" --argjson cleared "$DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON" --argjson rerowed "$REROWED_JSON" \
    --argjson rerun "$RERUN_JSON" --argjson pending "$(printf '%s' "$RERUN_LIST" | sed '/^$/d' | jq -R . | jq -sc .)" \
    --argjson outage "$OUTAGE_JSON" --argjson ohist "$OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON" \
    '{schema_version: 1, suite: "ablation-2.0", batch: $batch, smoke: $smoke, state: $state, per_arm: $per,
      retries: $retries, cuts: $cuts, paused_arms: $paused,
      spend: {rows_usd: ($rows_usd | tonumber), ledger_usd: ($ledger | tonumber), spent_usd: ($spent | tonumber),
              max_usd: (if $max == "" then null else ($max | tonumber) end), assumed_cap_trials: $assumed},
      trials_planned: $planned, resume_cursor: $cursor, drift: $drift, drift_cleared: $cleared, rerowed: $rerowed,
      rerun: $rerun, rerun_pending: $pending, outage: $outage, outage_history: $ohist,
      extra_models: ([$ebr | to_entries[] | .value | to_entries[]] | group_by(.key)
                     | map({key: .[0].key, value: {runs: length, output_tokens: (map(.value) | add)}}) | from_entries),
      extra_models_by_run: $ebr, rows_invalid: $invalid, signalled: $signalled,
      source_commit: $src, rows_file: $rows, started: $started, finished: $finished}' > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp"
  mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
}

cleanup() {
  local f p
  for f in "$JOBS_DIR"/*.pgid; do
    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
    read -r p _ < "$f" || continue
    kill -TERM -- "-$p" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
  done
  for p in $(jobs -p 2>/dev/null); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done
  rm -rf "$JOBS_DIR" "$LOCK" "$WORK" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

# --- one trial (a background job; its result goes to $JOBS_DIR/<jid>.*) -------------
fresh_dir() { local b="$1" k=2; [[ -e "$b" ]] || { printf '%s' "$b"; return; }; while [[ -e "$b-r$k" ]]; do k=$((k + 1)); done; printf '%s' "$b-r$k"; }
final_status() {  # final_status <run-dir> → the pipeline status, empty when missing or running
  local s; s="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$1/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  case "$s" in completed|agent_error|cap_failure|infrastructure_error|interrupted) printf '%s' "$s" ;; *) printf '' ;; esac
}
synthesize_record() {  # synthesize_record <run-dir> <arm> <task> <type> <trial> <run_id> <reason>
  local rd="$1"
  mkdir -p "$rd/meta"
  [[ -f "$rd/meta/arm" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$2" > "$rd/meta/arm"
  if ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$rd/meta/pipeline.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    jq -n --arg r "$6" --arg a "$2" --arg t "$3" --arg ty "$4" --argjson n "$5" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg why "$7" \
      --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg mode "$EXECUTOR" \
      '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $r, arm: $a, task_id: $t, task_type: $ty, trial: $n, source_commit: $src,
        status: "interrupted", reason: $why, cap_phase: null, spent_usd: 0, executor_mode: $mode, phases: [],
        snapshots: {}, started: $now, finished: $now, synthesized_by: "run-ablation.sh"}' > "$rd/meta/pipeline.json"

tool_use_result.stdout:
N_TASKS="$(jq 'length' "$WORK/tasks.json")"
PLAN_LINE="plan: ${#ARMS[@]} arms, $N_TASKS tasks, $PLAN_N trials, shuffle seed $SEED, est USD $EST_TOTAL (cap ${MAX_USD:-none}, run cap $RUN_CAP, reserve $(jq -r '.caps.reserve_usd // "n/a"' <<<"$SUITE_JSON"))"

write_manifest() {  # write_manifest <path> <dry_run>
  local out="$1" dry="$2" harness_commit harness_dirty=false
  harness_commit="$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
  [[ -n "$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" status --porcelain -- evals/harness evals/suites grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0 2>/dev/null)" ]] && harness_dirty=true
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
  printf '%s' "$DELTA" > "$WORK/delta.txt"
  printf '%s' "$GATE_JSON" > "$WORK/gate.json"
  jq -n \
    --slurpfile plan_f "$WORK/plan.json" --slurpfile suite_f "$WORK/suite.json" --slurpfile tasks_f "$WORK/tasks.json" \
    --slurpfile gate_f "$WORK/gate.json" --rawfile delta "$WORK/delta.txt" \
    --arg batch "$BATCH" --argjson dry "$dry" --argjson smoke "$SMOKE" --arg created "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg tree "$TREE" --arg hc "$harness_commit" --argjson hd "$harness_dirty" \
    --arg suite_file "${SUITE_FILE#"$REPO_ROOT"/}" --arg suite_file_path "$SUITE_FILE" --arg suite_root "$SUITE_ROOT" \
    --arg tasks_dir "$TASKS_DIR_NAME" --arg rows "$ROWS" --arg msha "$SUITE_MANIFEST_SHA" \
    --argjson arms "$(json_array "${ARMS[@]}")" --argjson tb "$TB" --argjson tr "$TR" --argjson seed "$SEED" \
    --arg fp "$FINGERPRINT" --arg image "$IMAGE" --arg digest "$IMAGE_DIGEST" --arg mode "$EXECUTOR" \
    --arg cli "$CLI_VERSION" --arg cli_raw "$CLI_RAW" --arg max_usd "$MAX_USD" --arg run_cap "$RUN_CAP" \
    --arg hb "$HINT_BUILD" --arg hr "$HINT_REVIEW" --argjson conc "$CONCURRENCY" --argjson rw "$RETRY_WAIT" \
    --arg wdo "$WATCHDOG_OVERRIDE" --argjson grace "$WATCHDOG_GRACE" --arg prr "$PRE_REG_REF" \
    --arg corpus "$CORPUS_SHA" --arg os "$(uname -srm)" --arg bash_v "$BASH_VERSION" \
    --arg jq_v "$(jq --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg yq_v "$(yq --version 2>/dev/null)" \
    --arg py_v "$(python3 --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg git_v "$(git --version 2>/dev/null)" '
    $plan_f[0] as $p | $suite_f[0] as $s | $gate_f[0] as $g
    | {schema_version: 1, suite: ($s.name // "ablation-2.0"), batch: $batch, dry_run: $dry, smoke: $smoke, created: $created,
       source_commit: $src, source_worktree: $tree, source_commit_dot_claude_delta: $delta,
       harness_commit: $hc, harness_dirty: $hd, suite_file: $suite_file, suite_file_path: $suite_file_path,
       suite_root: $suite_root, tasks_dir: $tasks_dir, rows_file: $rows,
       suite_version: ($s.suite_version // $s.version // null),
       suite_manifest_sha256: (if $msha == "" then null else $msha end),
       arms: $arms, tasks: [$tasks_f[0][] | {id, type}], refused: $p.refused,
       trials_per_type: {build: $tb, "review-catch": $tr}, trials_planned: ($p.plan | length),
       plan: $p.plan, arm_map: ([$p.plan[] | {(.run_id): .arm}] | add // {}),
       shuffle_seed: $seed, shuffle: "trial-major; python3 random.Random(shuffle_seed).shuffle per trial block, blocks in order",
       fingerprint: (if $fp == "" then null else $fp end), image: $image,
       image_digest: (if $digest == "" then null else $digest end), executor_mode: $mode,
       cli_version: $cli, cli_version_raw: $cli_raw,
       tools: ($s.phase_defaults.tools // null), phase_models: ($s.phase_defaults.models // {}),
       caps: {cycle_usd: ($s.caps.cycle_usd // null), run_usd: ($run_cap | tonumber), reserve_usd: ($s.caps.reserve_usd // null),
              max_usd: (if $max_usd == "" then null else ($max_usd | tonumber) end)},
       cost_hint: {build: ($hb | tonumber), "review-catch": ($hr | tonumber)},
       concurrency: $conc, retry: {transport_retries: 1, wait_s: $rw},
       watchdog: {multiplier: 2, override_s: (if $wdo == "" then null else ($wdo | tonumber) end), grace_s: $grace},
       pre_registration_ref: (if $prr == "" then null else $prr end),
       gate: $g, corpus: {manifest: "evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS", sha256: (if $corpus == "" then null else $corpus end)},
       agy_opt_in: ($s.agy_opt_in // false),
       environment: {os: $os, bash: $bash_v, jq: $jq_v, yq: $yq_v, python: $py_v, git: $git_v}}' > "$out.tmp"
  mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
}

if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == true ]]; then
  mpath="$MAN_PATH"; [[ -f "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json" ]] && mpath="$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.dry-run.json"
  write_manifest "$mpath" true
  echo "run-ablation (dry run): batch=$BATCH source=${SRC_FULL:0:12} executor=$EXECUTOR image=$IMAGE cli=$CLI_VERSION tree=$TREE"
  echo "$PLAN_LINE"
  jq -r '.refused[] | "refused: \(.arm) \(.task_id) \(.type) (task_types \(.task_types | tojson)) DEC-0405"' "$WORK/plan.json"
  jq -r '.[] | "\(.arm) \(.task_id) \(.type) \(.trial) \(.run_id)"' "$WORK/plan-only.json"
  echo "manifest: $mpath"
  exit 0
fi

# --- --clear-drift and --rerow: checked read-only before the lock (a refusal writes nothing) --
run_dir_of() {  # run_dir_of <run_id> → <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n> or its highest -r<k> sibling; empty when none
  local rel base best k max=1 d
  rel="$(jq -r --arg r "$1" '[.[] | select(.run_id == $r) | .run_dir][0] // ""' "$WORK/plan-only.json")"
  [[ -n "$rel" ]] || return 0
  base="$BATCH_DIR/$rel" best=""
  [[ -d "$base" ]] && best="$base"
  for d in "$base"-r*; do
    [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
    k="${d##*-r}"; [[ "$k" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
    if [[ $k -gt $max ]]; then max=$k best="$d"; fi
  done
  printf '%s' "$best"
}
CLEAR_PENDING=null
if [[ "$CLEAR_DRIFT" == true ]]; then
  old_drift="$(jq -c '.drift' "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json")"
  if [[ "$old_drift" == null ]]; then
    echo "run-ablation: resume: --clear-drift: the batch records no drift; nothing to clear" >&2
  else
    cd_rid="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' <<<"$old_drift")"
    cd_rd="$(run_dir_of "$cd_rid")"
    [[ -n "$cd_rd" && -f "$cd_rd/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || die "resume: --clear-drift: no run dir with meta/pipeline.json for the drifted run $cd_rid"
    cd_now="$(drift_check "$cd_rd" "$cd_rid" | sed -n 1p)" || cd_now=""
    [[ -n "$cd_now" ]] || die "resume: --clear-drift $cd_rid: the drift guard could not read $cd_rd"
    [[ "$cd_now" == null ]] || die "resume: --clear-drift $cd_rid: the run still drifts under the current rule: $cd_now"
    CLEAR_PENDING="$(jq -cn --arg r "$cd_rid" --argjson prev "$old_drift" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
      --arg hc "$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" \
      '{run_id: $r, previous: $prev, cleared_at: $at, harness_commit: $hc}')"
  fi
fi
RR_K=() RR_RD=() RR_FROM=() RR_ATT=() RR_REASON=()
for rid in ${REROW_IDS[@]+"${REROW_IDS[@]}"}; do
  [[ "$rid" == "$BATCH-"* ]] || die "--rerow $rid: not a run of batch $BATCH (<batch>-<arm>-<task>-t<n>)"
  k=-1
  for j in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do [[ "${PL_RUN[$j]}" == "$rid" ]] && { k=$j; break; }; done
  [[ $k -ge 0 ]] || die "--rerow $rid: not in the batch's plan"
  [[ -f "$ROWS" ]] || die "--rerow $rid: no rows file $ROWS"
  rr_rows="$(jq -R -c --arg b "$BATCH" --arg r "$rid" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b and .run_id == $r)' "$ROWS")"
  rr_n="$(grep -c . <<<"$rr_rows" || true)"
  [[ "$rr_n" -eq 1 ]] || die "--rerow $rid: $rr_n rows in $ROWS (a rerow replaces exactly one)"
  rr_st="$(jq -r '.status' <<<"$rr_rows")"
  case "$rr_st" in interrupted|transport_error) die "--rerow $rid: the row is $rr_st; that trial is a rerun (--resume after removing the row), not a rerow" ;; esac
  rr_rd="$(run_dir_of "$rid")"
  [[ -n "$rr_rd" && -f "$rr_rd/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || die "--rerow $rid: no run dir with meta/pipeline.json under $BATCH_DIR"
  RR_K+=("$k"); RR_RD+=("$rr_rd"); RR_FROM+=("$rr_st")
  RR_ATT+=("$(jq -r '.attempts // 1' <<<"$rr_rows")"); RR_REASON+=("$(jq -r '.retry_reason // ""' <<<"$rr_rows")")
done
for rid in ${RERUN_IDS[@]+"${RERUN_IDS[@]}"}; do
  [[ "$rid" == "$BATCH-"* ]] || die "--rerun $rid: not a run of batch $BATCH (<batch>-<arm>-<task>-t<n>)"
  k=-1
  for j in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do [[ "${PL_RUN[$j]}" == "$rid" ]] && { k=$j; break; }; done
  [[ $k -ge 0 ]] || die "--rerun $rid: not in the batch's plan"
  [[ -f "$ROWS" ]] || die "--rerun $rid: no rows file $ROWS"
  rn_rows="$(jq -R -c --arg b "$BATCH" --arg r "$rid" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b and .run_id == $r)' "$ROWS")"
  rn_n="$(grep -c . <<<"$rn_rows" || true)"
  [[ "$rn_n" -eq 1 ]] || die "--rerun $rid: $rn_n rows in $ROWS (a rerun replaces exactly one)"
  rn_st="$(jq -r '.status' <<<"$rn_rows")"
  case "$rn_st" in transport_error|interrupted|infrastructure_error) ;;
    *) die "--rerun $rid: the row is $rn_st; only transport_error, interrupted or infrastructure_error rows are rerun (DEC-0553)" ;; esac
done

# --- batch directory, lock, manifest ---------------------------------------------------
mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR"
LOCK="$BATCH_DIR/.lock"
rmdir_lock() { find "$LOCK" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true; }
if ! mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null; then
  oldpid="$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
  if [[ -n "$oldpid" ]] && kill -0 "$oldpid" 2>/dev/null; then die "batch $BATCH is locked by pid $oldpid ($LOCK)"; fi
  rm -rf "$LOCK"; mkdir "$LOCK" || die "cannot lock $LOCK"
fi
printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$LOCK/pid"
JOBS_DIR="$BATCH_DIR/.jobs"
# a driver killed with SIGKILL leaves its pipelines running in their own sessions: never start
# a second copy of a trial while the first still spends
for f in "$JOBS_DIR"/*.pgid; do
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
  read -r p _ < "$f" 2>/dev/null || continue
  if [[ "$p" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 -- "-$p" 2>/dev/null; then
    rmdir_lock
    die "a pipeline of an earlier driver still runs (process group $p, $f); stop it (kill -TERM -- -$p) or wait, then resume"
  fi
done
rm -rf "$JOBS_DIR"; mkdir -p "$JOBS_DIR"
rm -f "$BATCH_DIR/REFUSED.txt"
LOG="$BATCH_DIR/run.log"
if [[ "$SMOKE" != true && ! -f "$BATCH_DIR/.gitignore" ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' "# run-ablation.sh: run directories, logs and job state stay out of git;" \
    "# MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json and spend.txt are the batch record" "/*/" "/run.log" "/driver.log" "/.lock/" "/.jobs/" \
    > "$BATCH_DIR/.gitignore"
fi
[[ "$RESUME" == true ]] || write_manifest "$MAN_PATH" false
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$ROWS")"

# --- batch state ---------------------------------------------------------------------
STATE=running STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
SPENT=0 ASSUMED_CAP=0 CUT_JSON=null LAUNCHED=0 ROWS_USD=0 LEDGER_USD=0
CUTS_JSON='[]' RETRIES_JSON='[]' PAUSED_JSON='{}' DRIFT_JSON=null ROWS_INVALID=null STOP="" SIGNALLED=false
EXTRA_RUNS_JSON='{}' DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON='[]' REROWED_JSON='[]'
RERUN_JSON='[]' RERUN_OLD='{}' OUTAGE_JSON=null OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON='[]' OUTAGE_RUN=0
DONE_LIST=$'\n' RERUN_LIST=$'\n'
C_PLANNED=() C_LAUNCHED=() C_COMPLETED=() C_FAILED=() C_EXCLUDED=() C_CAP=() C_DEGRADED=() C_SKIPPED=()
for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do
  C_PLANNED[$i]=0; C_LAUNCHED[$i]=0; C_COMPLETED[$i]=0; C_FAILED[$i]=0; C_EXCLUDED[$i]=0; C_CAP[$i]=0; C_DEGRADED[$i]=0; C_SKIPPED[$i]=0
done
arm_index() { local i; for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do [[ "${ARMS[$i]}" == "$1" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done; echo -1; }
for a in ${PL_ARM[@]+"${PL_ARM[@]}"}; do i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_PLANNED[$i]=$(( ${C_PLANNED[$i]} + 1 )); done
is_done() { [[ "$DONE_LIST" == *$'\n'"$1"$'\n'* ]]; }
is_rerun() { [[ "$RERUN_LIST" == *$'\n'"$1"$'\n'* ]]; }   # flagged on resume, no replacement row yet
is_paused() { jq -e --arg a "$1" 'has($a)' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON" >/dev/null; }

# account_row <arm> <kind> <run_id> <status> <cost> <degraded> — counters and spend for one row
account_row() {
  local arm="$1" kind="$2" rid="$3" st="$4" cost="$5" deg="$6" i
  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
  case "$st" in
    completed) C_COMPLETED[$i]=$(( ${C_COMPLETED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
    cap_failure) C_CAP[$i]=$(( ${C_CAP[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
    agent_error) C_FAILED[$i]=$(( ${C_FAILED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
    *) C_EXCLUDED[$i]=$(( ${C_EXCLUDED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
  esac
  [[ "$deg" == true ]] && C_DEGRADED[$i]=$(( ${C_DEGRADED[$i]} + 1 ))
  ROWS_USD="$(fadd "$ROWS_USD" "$cost")"
  if [[ "$st" == cap_failure ]]; then
    if awk -v c="$cost" -v r="$RUN_CAP" 'BEGIN { exit !(c < r) }'; then
      SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
      log "assumed cap: $rid ended cap_failure at USD $cost; USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
    else
      SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
    fi
  else
    spend_charge "$st" "$cost" "$rid"
    if [[ "$st" == completed ]]; then est_record "$arm|$kind" "$kind" "$CHARGED_COST"; fi
  fi
}

resume_cursor() { local k; for k in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do is_done "${PL_RUN[$k]}" || { echo "$k"; return; }; done; echo "$PLAN_N"; }
write_status() {
  local per='{}' i finished=null
  for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do
    per="$(jq -c --arg a "${ARMS[$i]}" --argjson p "${C_PLANNED[$i]}" --argjson l "${C_LAUNCHED[$i]}" \
      --argjson c "${C_COMPLETED[$i]}" --argjson f "${C_FAILED[$i]}" --argjson x "${C_EXCLUDED[$i]}" \
      --argjson cap "${C_CAP[$i]}" --argjson d "${C_DEGRADED[$i]}" --argjson s "${C_SKIPPED[$i]}" \
      '. + {($a): {trials_planned: $p, launched: $l, completed: $c, failed: $f, excluded: $x, cap_failures: $cap,
                   degraded: $d, skipped_paused: $s}}' <<<"$per")"
  done
  [[ "$STATE" != running ]] && finished="\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\""
  jq -n --arg batch "$BATCH" --argjson smoke "$SMOKE" --arg state "$STATE" --argjson per "$per" \
    --argjson retries "$RETRIES_JSON" --argjson cuts "$CUTS_JSON" --argjson paused "$PAUSED_JSON" \
    --arg rows_usd "$ROWS_USD" --arg ledger "$LEDGER_USD" --arg spent "$SPENT" --arg max "$MAX_USD" \
    --argjson assumed "$ASSUMED_CAP" --argjson cursor "$(resume_cursor)" --argjson drift "$DRIFT_JSON" \
    --argjson invalid "$ROWS_INVALID" --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" \
    --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg rows "$ROWS" --argjson planned "$PLAN_N" --argjson signalled "$SIGNALLED" \
    --argjson ebr "$EXTRA_RUNS_JSON" --argjson cleared "$DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON" --argjson rerowed "$REROWED_JSON" \
    --argjson rerun "$RERUN_JSON" --argjson pending "$(printf '%s' "$RERUN_LIST" | sed '/^$/d' | jq -R . | jq -sc .)" \
    --argjson outage "$OUTAGE_JSON" --argjson ohist "$OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON" \
    '{schema_version: 1, suite: "ablation-2.0", batch: $batch, smoke: $smoke, state: $state, per_arm: $per,
      retries: $retries, cuts: $cuts, paused_arms: $paused,
      spend: {rows_usd: ($rows_usd | tonumber), ledger_usd: ($ledger | tonumber), spent_usd: ($spent | tonumber),
              max_usd: (if $max == "" then null else ($max | tonumber) end), assumed_cap_trials: $assumed},
      trials_planned: $planned, resume_cursor: $cursor, drift: $drift, drift_cleared: $cleared, rerowed: $rerowed,
      rerun: $rerun, rerun_pending: $pending, outage: $outage, outage_history: $ohist,
      extra_models: ([$ebr | to_entries[] | .value | to_entries[]] | group_by(.key)
                     | map({key: .[0].key, value: {runs: length, output_tokens: (map(.value) | add)}}) | from_entries),
      extra_models_by_run: $ebr, rows_invalid: $invalid, signalled: $signalled,
      source_commit: $src, rows_file: $rows, started: $started, finished: $finished}' > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp"
  mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
}

cleanup() {
  local f p
  for f in "$JOBS_DIR"/*.pgid; do
    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
    read -r p _ < "$f" || continue
    kill -TERM -- "-$p" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
  done
  for p in $(jobs -p 2>/dev/null); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done
  rm -rf "$JOBS_DIR" "$LOCK" "$WORK" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

# --- one trial (a background job; its result goes to $JOBS_DIR/<jid>.*) -------------
fresh_dir() { local b="$1" k=2; [[ -e "$b" ]] || { printf '%s' "$b"; return; }; while [[ -e "$b-r$k" ]]; do k=$((k + 1)); done; printf '%s' "$b-r$k"; }
final_status() {  # final_status <run-dir> → the pipeline status, empty when missing or running
  local s; s="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$1/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  case "$s" in completed|agent_error|cap_failure|infrastructure_error|interrupted) printf '%s' "$s" ;; *) printf '' ;; esac
}
synthesize_record() {  # synthesize_record <run-dir> <arm> <task> <type> <trial> <run_id> <reason>
  local rd="$1"
  mkdir -p "$rd/meta"
  [[ -f "$rd/meta/arm" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$2" > "$rd/meta/arm"
  if ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$rd/meta/pipeline.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    jq -n --arg r "$6" --arg a "$2" --arg t "$3" --arg ty "$4" --argjson n "$5" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg why "$7" \
      --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg mode "$EXECUTOR" \
      '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $r, arm: $a, task_id: $t, task_type: $ty, trial: $n, source_commit: $src,
        status: "interrupted", reason: $why, cap_phase: null, spent_usd: 0, executor_mode: $mode, phases: [],
        snapshots: {}, started: $now, finished: $now, synthesized_by: "run-ablation.sh"}' > "$rd/meta/pipeline.json"

# --- --rerow: the post-run chain again over a rowed run dir, the row replaced in place ---
# replace_row_try <run_id> <new-row-file> → 0 replaced; 1 with REPLACE_ERR set and the rows file
# untouched (the old row stays). replace_row is the --rerow form: it dies instead
replace_row_try() {
  local rid="$1" newf="$2" tmp="$ROWS.rerow.$$" rc=0 vout="" perr
  REPLACE_ERR=""
  local -a v=("$ROW_BIN" --validate "$tmp"); [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]] && v+=(--allow-ungraded)
  {
    command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 && flock -x 9
    perr="$(python3 -I - "$ROWS" "$tmp" "$BATCH" "$rid" "$newf" 2>&1 <<'PY'
import json, sys
rows, tmp, batch, rid, newf = sys.argv[1:6]
new = open(newf, encoding="utf-8").read().strip()
out, n = [], 0
with open(rows, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    for line in fh:
        try: o = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError: o = None
        if isinstance(o, dict) and o.get("batch") == batch and o.get("run_id") == rid:
            n += 1; out.append(new + "\n")
        else:
            out.append(line if line.endswith("\n") else line + "\n")
if n != 1:
    print("run_id %s has %d rows" % (rid, n), file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh: fh.writelines(out)
PY
)" || rc=$?
    if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then
      vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || rc=$?
      if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then mv "$tmp" "$ROWS"; else REPLACE_ERR="$(printf '%s\n' "$vout" | tail -1)"; fi
    else
      REPLACE_ERR="$(printf '%s\n' "$perr" | tail -1)"
    fi
  } 9>>"$ROWS.lock"
  rm -f "$tmp"
  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || { REPLACE_ERR="${REPLACE_ERR:-exit $rc}"; return 1; }
  return 0
}
replace_row() {  # replace_row <run_id> <new-row-file> → 0 replaced; dies (rows file untouched) otherwise
  replace_row_try "$1" "$2" && return 0
  printf '%s\n' "$REPLACE_ERR" >&2
  die "rerow $1: the replacement did not validate or the row moved ($REPLACE_ERR); $ROWS unchanged"
}
rerow_all() {
  local n k rid arm task trial rd tlog newst
  for n in "${!RR_K[@]}"; do
    k="${RR_K[$n]}" rid="${PL_RUN[${RR_K[$n]}]}" arm="${PL_ARM[${RR_K[$n]}]}" task="${PL_TASK[${RR_K[$n]}]}"
    trial="${PL_TRIAL[${RR_K[$n]}]}" rd="${RR_RD[$n]}" tlog="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial.log"
    printf '%s run-ablation: rerow %s run_dir %s (was %s)\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$rd" "${RR_FROM[$n]}" >> "$tlog"
    rm -f "$WORK/rerow-$n.row"
    post_run "$rd" "$rid" "$task" "${PL_YAML[$k]}" "${RR_ATT[$n]}" "${RR_REASON[$n]}" "$(final_status "$rd")" "" "$WORK/rerow-$n.row" "$tlog"
    [[ -s "$WORK/rerow-$n.row" ]] || die "rerow $rid: ablation-row.sh wrote no row (exit $PR_RRC; see $tlog); $ROWS unchanged"
    replace_row "$rid" "$WORK/rerow-$n.row"
    newst="$(jq -r '.status' "$WORK/rerow-$n.row")"
    record_extra "$rid" "$PR_EXTRA"
    apply_flags "$arm" "$rid" "$PR_TE" "$PR_TE_REASON" "$PR_DRIFT"
    REROWED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg f "${RR_FROM[$n]}" --arg t "$newst" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
      '. + [{run_id: $r, from: $f, to: $t, at: $at}]' <<<"$REROWED_JSON")"
    jq --argjson r "$REROWED_JSON" '.rerowed = $r' "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json" > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" \
      && mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
    log "rerow $rid: ${RR_FROM[$n]} → $newst"
  done
  return 0
}

# --- --resume reconciliation: rows on disk are the truth (after --rerow) --------
if [[ "$RESUME" == true ]]; then
  ST_PATH="$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
  STARTED="$(jq -r '.started // empty' "$ST_PATH")"; [[ -n "$STARTED" ]] || STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  CUTS_JSON="$(jq -c '.cuts // []' "$ST_PATH")"; RETRIES_JSON="$(jq -c '.retries // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c '.paused_arms // {}' "$ST_PATH")"
  LEDGER_USD="$(jq -r '.spend.ledger_usd // 0' "$ST_PATH")"; SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$LEDGER_USD")"
  EXTRA_RUNS_JSON="$(jq -c '.extra_models_by_run // {} | if type == "object" then . else {} end' "$ST_PATH")"
  DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON="$(jq -c '.drift_cleared // []' "$ST_PATH")"; REROWED_JSON="$(jq -c '.rerowed // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  RERUN_JSON="$(jq -c '.rerun // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON="$(jq -c '.outage_history // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  if [[ "$(jq -c '.outage // null' "$ST_PATH")" != null ]]; then
    OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson o "$(jq -c '.outage' "$ST_PATH")" '. + [$o]' <<<"$OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON")"
    log "resume: the outage breaker record $(jq -c '.outage' "$ST_PATH") is cleared (kept under outage_history)"
  fi
  if [[ "$CLEAR_PENDING" != null ]]; then
    DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson c "$CLEAR_PENDING" '. + [$c]' <<<"$DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON")"
    log "resume: --clear-drift $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$CLEAR_PENDING") (previous drift re-read under the current rule: none)"
  fi
  for a in ${CLEAR_ARMS[@]+"${CLEAR_ARMS[@]}"}; do
    if is_paused "$a"; then PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg a "$a" 'del(.[$a])' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"; log "resume: --clear-arm $a (paused arm released)"
    else log "resume: --clear-arm $a: the arm is not paused"; fi
  done
